newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end down,reflecting Chicago dip.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end down,reflecting Chicago dip.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower in all contract months on Tuesday, reflecting an overnight fall in the Chicago market, traders said.
Prices were 110 to 250 yen per tonne lower, with the benchmark May 1998 contract down 130 yen at 15,680 yen.
The CBOT corn market closed lower on Monday on projections of rapid planting progress across the U.S. Midwest.
Active selling from individual investors hit the Tokyo market from the opening, depressing all contract months, traders said. Weak sentiment stemming from CBOT accelerated selling later, they said.
The spot May contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.92-1/2 per bushel at 0645 GMT, against the Monday close of $2.93.
The spot May contract on CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $8.93-1/2 at 0645 GMT, against $8.93 at Monday's close. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk (+81-3-3432-7391)
